A Native Scrobbler for Windows 11


Fluent Scrobbler — 1.2 Release Notes (2026-10-24)
Fluent Scrobbler 1.2 introduces granular playback and scrobbling controls, alongside essential stability fixes, integration improvements, and memory optimizations across the app.
New Features
- Playback & Scrobbling controls: Added a dedicated settings group with granular submission rules:
  - Send Now Playing: Submits real-time playback status to connected scrobbling services.
  - Scrobble delay percentage: Configures tracks to scrobble only after reaching a specific percentage of playback.
  - Maximum wait time: Sets an upper time limit for scrobble submission on long tracks.
Bug Fixes
- Scrobbling reliability: Improved error handling, fixed track submission loss caused by slow network conditions, resolved fragile replay detection, and restored offline cache worker stability.
- Player integration fixes: Resolved an issue where Winamp tracks without duration metadata waited 240 seconds to scrobble, prevented loop hangs when Winamp freezes, fixed missing cover art on Deezer, and corrected SMTC manager resets.
- Application stability: Resolved a UI exception that could cause application crashes and plugged a memory leak in HomePage.
- Discord Rich Presence: Cleaned up verbose logging and resolved minor connection issues with Discord RPC.
- System and storage fixes: Switched to atomic JSON writes to prevent configuration corruption, fixed configuration import/export, and corrected the F12 screenshot shortcut.
Enhancements
- General performance: Simplified internal background logic and optimized thread-safe collections for lower resource consumption.
- Interface and installer polish: Updated the "New Features" badge and resolved installer integrity checks.
Bug Reports & Support
Despite our best efforts to ensure a polished release, bugs may occasionally occur. If you encounter any issues, please open a bug report here.
Enjoying Fluent Scrobbler?
Consider supporting the project on Buy Me a Coffee to help fund future improvements. You can also help us grow by leaving a review or sharing the app with friends!
